english.title: Driver of a relevant vehicle fail to carry evidence of CPC obtained in member state / Gibraltar
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who held

(A)_[a CPC certifying an initial qualification for the purposes of point (a) of Article 6(1) of Section 1 of Part B of Annex 31 to the Trade and Cooperation Agreement]_
(B)_[a written record certifying an initial qualification obtained in a specified EEA state or Gibraltar and recognised by the competent authority as equivalent to a CPC certifying an initial qualification for the purposes of point (a) of Article 6(1) of Section 1 of Part B of Annex 31 to the Trade and Cooperation Agreement]_
(C)_[an initial CPC obtained in a member State or Gibraltar]_

and who drove a relevant vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), failed to carry in that vehicle evidence as specified in paragraph (2)(a) of the initial CPC held by you
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 11(3) and (8) of the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the driver a relevant vehicle on a road
to whom regulation 4(9) of the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007 applied OR
who holds an initial CPC obtained in a member State or Gibraltar
and having been required to hold
evidence specified in paragraph 2(a) of the initial CPC
failed to have with him / her in the vehicle evidence of being the holder of such a certificate

english.notes:
(i) These regulations apply to persons driving a bus on or after 10th September 2008 or driving a lorry on or after 10th September 2009.
(ii) See regulation 3(2) for vehicles to which these regulations DO NOT apply.
(iii) This offence applies from the 3rd December 2024 due to changes made by SI 2024/1160 to the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007 and applies to a person outlined in regulation 4(9). For the offence relating to a person specified in regulation 4(9A), see H101934. For the offences applying before the 3rd December 2024, see H21543.
